name: Marvelous Fantasia
type: Whiteout Survival Honor Festival mini-game; unofficial practice mode

rules.selectableTiles: A tile can be selected when no other tile covers it.
rules.matching: Three identical tiles in storage clear automatically.
rules.win: Clear every board tile with storage empty.
rules.loss: The run ends when all storage slots are occupied without a match.

helpers.Withdraw: Return the last stored tile to the board.
helpers.Remove: Send the three most accessible tiles to storage.

eventFacts.helperItems: Withdraw, Reconstruct, and Remove are real event items; the source page says Marvelous Boost packs may provide additional copies while the event is live.

practiceMode.boardLayouts: Procedurally generated; they do not match exact live-event layouts.
practiceMode.visualAssets: Original inline vector tile illustrations created for this package; no source-site artwork or code included.
practiceMode.helperUse: One use of each helper per practice level, for balance. This practice limit is a local design choice, not an official game rule.
practiceMode.leaderboard: Not included; the package has no connected backend.

leaderboard.sourcePage: Best level reached per player; signed-in players can opt in to publish under a chosen public name; the page states real names and email addresses are not shown.
leaderboard.localPackage: No login, upload, or leaderboard submission is included in this standalone practice game.

tutorial: The source page links a video tutorial; the linked video content was not reproduced.
